prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1311; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim file reference. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was involved in the parking lot incident.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where the collision occurred?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot here in Baytown, near the far row of spaces by the loading area. I was backing out of a space when another car came down the lane pretty fast.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Only for a second. I had my foot on the brake and turned to look over my shoulder, and then it hit the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving?

A: Walking speed, maybe less. I was barely rolling.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the collision?

A: My knee hit the dashboard when we jolted. It hurt right away, but I figured it was just a bruise and I drove myself home.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since then?

A: Yes, a couple of days later the knee was swollen and I couldn't bend it well. I went to urgent care, and they recommended an X-ray and a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Do you have any prior injuries to that same knee?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness from running a few years ago, but nothing that required treatment.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been keeping copies of my medical bills and my repair estimate, and I can send them over whenever you need them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
